topic: Law of Conservation of Mechanical Energy
key_concepts: Potential energy is stored energy due to position or height
Potential energy is calculated as PE = mgh
Kinetic energy is energy of motion
Kinetic energy is calculated as KE = 1/2mv²
Potential and kinetic energy are forms of mechanical energy
Total mechanical energy is the sum of potential and kinetic energy
The unit of energy is the joule
In an isolated system with only conservative forces, total mechanical energy is conserved
A conservative force does work independent of the path taken
Change in total mechanical energy equals zero: ΔKE + ΔPE = 0
In a pendulum, potential energy is maximum at the highest points and kinetic energy is max
